summary: Connects a sequence of faces or surfaces into one primitive, optionally changing connected ends and converting simpler primitives to Bezier/NURBS as needed.
common_gotchas: Mixed face and surface primitive types cannot be joined together.
Conversion to Bezier or NURBS can surprise downstream type-specific SOPs.
`inc` and `skip` affect how primitives are grouped for joining.
key_concepts: Join SOP joins a sequence of faces or surfaces into one primitive.
It can join faces to faces or surfaces to surfaces, but mixed face/surface inputs are invalid.
Simpler primitives may be converted to Bezier or NURBS to perform the join.
Join differs from Fillet and Stitch because it turns multiple primitives into one and can change connected ends.
